|extra_sections=<h2>Publication history</h2>
The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original (unnumbered)''' ([[Luke Skywalker (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Original unnumbered)|Luke Skywalker (V) — Original (unnumbered)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #1a sheet (PDF made 5 March 2002; tournament-legal 9 March 2002). Full text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots (and to Attack Run total if piloting lead starfighter). If piloting at a battleground during your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force or take Darklighter Spin into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
* '''Numbered''' ([[Luke Skywalker (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Numbered)|Luke Skywalker (V) — Numbered]]): the Virtual Set #1 sheet hosted by Decipher (PDF made 6 March 2002; tournament-legal 9 March 2002). Full text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots (and to Attack Run total if piloting lead starfighter). If piloting at a battleground during your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force or take Darklighter Spin into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same as the previous version; the slip's look differs (Decipher's sheet prints Dark Side text boxes black on white and prints collector numbers V1•1–V1•12; the 5 March sheet prints Dark Side boxes white on black and no numbers). Listed as its own version because it is a separate publication (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Remastered (2006)''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 1: Legacy, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “[Pilot] 3. If piloting lead starfighter, Attack Run total is +3. During your control phase, if piloting at a battleground, may ▲ one Darklighter Spin or retrieve 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' the pilot bonus is printed as [Pilot] 3; the Attack Run bonus is a separate sentence; the control-phase clause uses the printed ▲ shorthand before Darklighter Spin and separately prints “retrieve 1 Force”.
|sources=* Historical PC full-card image: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071218114451/http://www.swccgpc.com/cards/v1/ls/lukeskywalkerv.gif Luke Skywalker], swccgpc.com (Internet Archive, 18 December 2007).
* Publisher slip and card text: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153847/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards1.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards1.pdf, page 2, card 05], Players Committee; official text as of 4 December 2006 (Internet Archive, 24 October 2007).
